description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'WorkWeekAPI' within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It handles retrieving and updating work week configurations for leave management, supporting GET and PUT HTTP methods, with validation and model selection based on query parameters.

classes.name: WorkWeekAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for retrieving and updating work week configurations in the leave module of OrangeHRM system, supporting model selection, validation, and CRUD operations (GET and PUT).

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific WorkWeek record by ID, returning it in the requested model format.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the class name of the model to be used based on query parameter.

methods.name: getModelParamRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getIdFromUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts the WorkWeek record ID from URL attribute parameters.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring the ID parameter is positive integer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' method, validating ID and model parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the WorkWeek record with data provided in the request body for each day of the week.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating, including ID and daily work hours validations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; deletion not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; deletion validation not supported.
